<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>LlmTornado.Mcp</id>
    <version>1.1.64</version>
    <authors>LlmTornado.Mcp</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>nuget_logo.jpg</icon>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/lofcz/LlmTornado</projectUrl>
    <description>Connect agents to data sources, tools, and workflows via Model Context Protocol (MCP).</description>
    <tags>mcp sdk agent workflow orchestration multi-agent agents rag</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/lofcz/LlmTornado" commit="825daabfb71649ada76358bb1060533fea3e036c" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="LlmTornado" version="3.8.67" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="ModelContextProtocol" version="1.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="LlmTornado" version="3.8.67" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="ModelContextProtocol" version="1.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard2.0">
        <dependency id="LlmTornado" version="3.8.67" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="ModelContextProtocol" version="1.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
